personality_profile.leadership_style: Command-and-trust: establishes clear systems, delegates within those systems, holds accountability rigorously. Leads by example on the floor.
personality_profile.decision_making_pattern: Evidence-first, systematic. Resists decisions made without understanding the root cause. Slow to commit, highly reliable once committed.
personality_profile.stress_response: Becomes quieter and more focused under pressure. Teams find this stabilising. Does not escalate emotionally.
personality_profile.collaboration_style: Builds trust slowly. Loyal once trust is established. Resistant to collaboration imposed through hierarchy rather than earned through demonstrated competence.

hr_assessment.promotion_trajectory: Ready now for VP Operations in a pure operational context. 12-18 months for roles requiring C-suite political navigation or transformation leadership.
hr_assessment.key_strength_observed: Unmatched operational credibility and crisis containment capability. The standard-setter for plant-level excellence in the group.
hr_assessment.development_area: Board-level communication and digital transformation leadership. Needs executive coaching to navigate abstraction and political complexity at VP level.
hr_assessment.raw_opinion: Thomas has been one of our most reliable operational managers for the past 14 years. He is the person we call when something is on fire and we need it contained. His floor-level credibility is unmatched in the Leipzig region. The honest concern is that he has never operated above the plant level. His digital transformation engagement is minimal. Retention risk is low — deeply rooted in Leipzig with family.

tension_summary: The most trusted crisis operator in the group — but his entire identity is built on operational mastery within a stable system, and any role that requires him to dismantle rather than optimise that system will expose the exact blind spots that have never been tested.
